steps.say: Most penile cancers are grouped sharing one histology. Squamous cell carcinoma is found in over ninety five percent. High risk HPV is blamed driving a large subset. Types sixteen with eighteen are blamed in thirty to fifty percent. Circumcision with hygiene is staged lowering the risk markedly. Smoking cessation is advised at diagnosis.
steps.tx: **Squamous cell carcinoma** (skin type cancer), SCC, causes over **95%** (ninety five in a hundred) of penile cancers, with high-risk **HPV 16** (wart virus sixteen) and **HPV 18** (wart virus eighteen) driving **30% to 50%** (three to five in ten). Promote neonatal circumcision, hygiene, and smoking cessation. Vaccinate boys against HPV, because prevention beats morbid surgery.

steps.say: Red patches on the penis are staged deserving biopsy. Erythroplasia of Queyrat is mapped affecting glans with prepuce. Bowen disease is staged involving the penile shaft instead. Both are staged as carcinoma in situ. Topical or laser therapy is offered for small areas. Wide excision is booked for extensive disease.
steps.tx: **Erythroplasia of Queyrat** (red glans patch) of glans and prepuce plus **Bowen disease** (scaly shaft patch) of the shaft are both **carcinoma in situ** (Tis surface cancer). Biopsy every persistent red or scaly lesion. Treat small areas with topical or laser therapy, because invasion hides beneath innocent looks.

vis.alt: Clinical inspection of penile lesions and premalignant patches.
vis.caption: Examine every patch: Queyrat and Bowen are carcinoma in situ. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Small low risk tumours are managed keeping the organ. Wide excision with glansectomy is offered for T1 disease. Mohs surgery is staged sparing tissue with mapped margins. Clear margins of three to five mm are required throughout. Reconstruction is completed using skin grafts routinely. Function with appearance is preserved together.
steps.tx: **Organ-sparing surgery** (penis saving excision) by wide local excision, **glansectomy** (glans removal) with skin graft, or Mohs micrographic surgery controls low-risk T1 disease with clear **surgical margin** (cancer free edge) of **3 mm to 5 mm** (three to five millimetres). Map margins microscopically before reconstruction. Reserve amputation for deeper invasion, because length matters to patients.

steps.say: Deeper tumours are managed by partial removal alone. Partial penectomy is performed for invasive T2 disease. A stump of two to three cm is preserved deliberately. Upright voiding with seated stability is maintained. A spatulated neo-meatus is fashioned at the tip. Counselling is staged covering standing versus sitting beforehand.
steps.tx: **Partial penectomy** (part shaft removal) with spatulated **neo-meatus** (new opening) suits invasive T2 tumours when a functional stump of at least **2 cm to 3 cm** (two to three centimetres) allows upright micturition. Fashion a wide ventral slit to resist stenosis. Counsel voiding posture and sexual change honestly, because expectations shape recovery.

steps.say: Groin nodes are staged deciding survival in penile cancer. Inguinal dissection is mandated for intermediate high risk tumours. T1G3 with T2 or higher disease is added routinely. Palpation is staged missing hidden deposits too often. Occult micrometastases are hidden in twenty to twenty five percent. Surgery is staged before spread declares itself.
steps.tx: **Inguinal lymphadenectomy** (groin node clearance), ILND, is mandatory for T1G3 and T2 or higher tumours, because palpation misses **occult micrometastases** (hidden nodal deposits) in **20% to 25%** (two in ten) of clinically negative groins. Dissect both groins when risk is bilateral. Refer to expert centres, because wound morbidity needs specialist care.

vis.alt: Penile cancer presentation with inguinal nodal spread.
vis.caption: Groin staging: occult deposits hide in twenty to twenty five percent. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Full groin clearance is staged wounding many patients. Dynamic sentinel biopsy is staged mapping the groin selectively. Technetium nanocolloid with blue dye is tracked to the first node. Patent blue or ICG dye is injected for visual mapping. Wound morbidity is recorded falling far below full dissection. Thirty to fifty percent morbidity is avoided by selection.
steps.tx: **Dynamic sentinel node biopsy** (first node sampling), **DSNB** (selective groin staging), with **technetium-99m** (radioactive tracer) nanocolloid plus patent blue or ICG maps the sentinel node while sparing the **30% to 50%** (three to five in ten) wound morbidity of full dissection. Remove only hot or blue nodes with backup dissection ready. Repeat staging when mapping fails, because missed nodes kill.

steps.say: Pelvic nodes are staged following groin positivity. Bilateral pelvic dissection is added for heavy groin disease. Two or more positive inguinal nodes are counted triggering the extension. Extracapsular spread is added earning pelvic clearance. Imaging with operative findings is staged setting the field. Adjuvant therapy is planned on final pathology.
steps.tx: **Pelvic lymphadenectomy** (deep node clearance) is added bilaterally for two or more positive inguinal nodes or **extracapsular extension** (burst nodal spread, pN2 or pN3 disease). Clear external iliac and obturator packets in continuity. Let final pathology set adjuvant therapy, because pelvic positivity changes prognosis.

steps.say: Bulky groin disease is staged starting with drugs first. Fixed ulcerated or bulky nodes are treated first systemically. Paclitaxel with ifosfamide and cisplatin are combined as TIP. Response is judged after three or four courses. Consolidation surgery is booked promptly for responders. Unresectable cases are kept continuing palliative courses.
steps.tx: **TIP regimen** (penile cancer drug triad) of paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin is the **neoadjuvant chemotherapy penile cancer** (pre-surgery drug standard) for fixed, ulcerated, or bulky nodes before consolidation surgery. Judge response after three to four courses. Operate on responders and palliate the rest, because surgery cures only chemo responsive disease.
